file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/ingest/parser.ts, parseStatement splits the text by '\n' and pops a trailing empty line if lines[lines.length - 1] === '', but does not handle lines that contain a carriage return '\r' (i.e. '\r\n') where the last line becomes '\r', causing it not to be popped and failing with a Malformed row error.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Transaction amounts in Ledgerline are stored as exact integers in minor units (bigint) alongside their ISO 4217 currency code, avoiding any floating-point rounding issues. As documented in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, currencies without minor units like the Japanese yen (JPY) are stored directly as whole units.

file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/ingest/parser.ts, text.split("\n") creates an empty string line when the file ends with a newline, but the check lines[lines.length - 1] === "" only pops the last line if it's empty, and if there are multiple trailing newlines or Windows CRLF line endings (\r\n), lines ending with \r are not popped and are parsed as a row with incorrect field count. We should filter out completely empty lines or lines containing only whitespace/cr when parsing lines in parseStatement so that trailing newlines don't cause malformed data row errors.

title: Fix integer configuration parsing in src/config.ts
body:
File: src/config.ts

Validate configuration integer values or parse duration suffixes (such as 'h') in the int helper function in src/config.ts so that non-integer values like '12h' cause a startup error or are parsed correctly.

title: Fix export filename date using local time instead of UTC
body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Change formatExportFilename to use local date formatting instead of toISOString(), which uses UTC. This ensures evening exports in western time zones display the correct local date instead of tomorrow's UTC date.

title: Persist export format selection in localStorage
body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Update ExportButton to load and save the selected export format in localStorage so it remembers the user's last chosen format across reports and sessions.

title: Handle trailing carriage returns in parser.ts
body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Update parser.ts to handle trailing carriage returns (CRLF / \r) when popping empty lines at the end of the file.

title: Update README.md with MinIO S3_ENDPOINT and bucket creation steps
body:
File: README.md

Update README.md to mention setting S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 and creating the bucket when using MinIO locally.

title: Add name filter parameter to GET /reports endpoint
body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Add a name filter parameter to the reports list endpoint and report repository list function so clients can filter reports by name.

title: Separate error toasts to use assertive aria-live and no auto-dismiss
body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider and Toast component in src/components/Toast.tsx to separate error toasts so they use aria-live="assertive" and do not auto-dismiss after five seconds.

title: Validate integer configuration values in src/config.ts
body:
File: src/config.ts

Validate integer configuration values in src/config.ts to ensure that they are valid integers and do not contain trailing non-numeric characters (like 'h'), or throw an error when parsing fails or has trailing junk.

title: Fix report copy name truncation in src/api/reports.ts
body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Truncate the source report name before appending ' (copy)' to ensure the suffix is never truncated when names are near the 120-character limit.

title: Document password validation rules for POST /auth/password-reset/confirm
body:
File: docs/API.md

Update docs/API.md under the POST /auth/password-reset/confirm endpoint to specify that the new password must be between 10 and 200 characters long, matching the validation rules enforced in src/api/auth.ts.

title: Fix formatExportFilename to use local date instead of UTC
body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Change formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts to use local date components (e.g. getFullYear(), getMonth(), getDate()) instead of toISOString() so that the date matches the user's local time zone rather than UTC.

title: Parse quality values in pickLocale for Accept-Language header
body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

Update pickLocale to correctly parse quality values (q-factors) from the Accept-Language header instead of just taking the first comma-separated locale, ensuring language selection respects client preferences.

title: Support Unicode letters in slugify for non-Latin characters
body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

Update slugify to support Unicode letters such as Greek and Cyrillic instead of restricting to ASCII [a-z0-9] so that non-Latin characters are preserved in generated slugs and filenames.

title: Add a name filter parameter to the reports list endpoint
body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Add a name filter parameter to the reports list endpoint and report repository to filter saved reports by name.

title: Clear problem state on file selection in UploadForm
body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

Clear the problem state (setProblem(null)) in the file input's onChange handler when a new file is chosen so that stale error messages do not persist.

title: src/util/money.ts: support more currency symbols and codes in parseAmount
body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update parseAmount in src/util/money.ts to strip out any leading or trailing currency symbols/letters instead of only hardcoded €, $, £, ¥ (e.g. handle ₹, CHF, and general currency signs/codes).

title: Truncate source report name before appending (copy) in src/api/reports.ts
body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Truncate the source report name to MAX_NAME_LENGTH - 7 before appending ' (copy)' instead of truncating the combined string, so the resulting name does not get cut off prematurely when it exceeds the maximum length.

title: Update password validation rules in API docs
body:
File: docs/API.md

Update docs/API.md under POST /auth/password-reset/confirm to specify that the password must be between 10 and 200 characters long, matching the validation rules defined in src/api/auth.ts.

body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

Update `pickLocale` in `src/i18n/index.ts` to parse `q=` quality values from the `Accept-Language` header and select the supported language with the highest weight instead of the first listed language.

Update ExportButton to read and write the last used export format from localStorage, so user preference for the export format is preserved across sessions.

title: Support non-Latin character sets in slugify
body:

Update slugify or export filename handling to support non-Latin character sets (such as Greek and Cyrillic) instead of stripping them out entirely.

body:

Add instructions to set `S3_ENDPOINT` (and optionally create the bucket) in the local setup steps in README.md when using MinIO.

In parseStatement, filter out or ignore empty lines or carriage returns at the end of the text so that trailing blank lines with \r\n do not cause a 'Malformed row' error.

Update formatExportFilename to use local date components rather than toISOString(), preventing dates from rolling over to the next day in western time zones during the evening due to UTC conversion.

Update the regex in parseAmount in src/util/money.ts to include the rupee sign (₹) and handle currency symbols like CHF more robustly so that amounts using them parse correctly.

Filter out completely empty lines (or lines containing only whitespace/cr) when splitting or parsing lines in parseStatement, so that trailing newlines or Windows CRLF line endings do not cause empty lines to be treated as malformed data rows.

body:

Truncate the source report name before appending ' (copy)' rather than appending ' (copy)' to the full name and truncating the result, ensuring ' (copy)' is never cut off by name length limits.

body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update the Toast component and/or ToastProvider so that error toasts use aria-live="assertive" (or role="alert") and do not automatically dismiss after five seconds, ensuring critical errors are announced properly and remain visible to users.

title: Preserve Greek and Cyrillic characters in src/util/strings.ts slugify
body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

Update the slugify implementation in src/util/strings.ts to preserve Greek and Cyrillic character ranges (or unicode letters generally) rather than restricting strictly to [a-z0-9], ensuring report names in those scripts are not stripped out of export file names.

title: Parse q quality values in pickLocale for accurate language selection
body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

Update `pickLocale` in `src/i18n/index.ts` to parse `q` quality values from the Accept-Language header and choose the supported language with the highest preference score, instead of simply returning the first supported language in comma-separated order.

title: Clear upload error state when selecting a new file in UploadForm
body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

Clear the upload error/problem state (i.e. setProblem(null)) when a new file is chosen in the file input onChange handler, so previous error states do not linger when attempting to upload a new file.
